messages:
nina: Heads up — seeing a bunch of traces with missing child spans for /infer routes since ~02:15 UTC. Parent request spans are there but model/worker spans are mostly absent. Customer-facing error rate spiked.
karim: Yep, noticed same. gpu-worker pods show regular logs but no spans emitted. otel-collector logs around 02:10 show exporter 429s to the long-term store.
otel-bot: alert: exporter_queue_drops > 50 (collector-prod) — triggered 02:12:43 UTC
rachel: I flipped the routing policy canary to global at 01:50 for the new route-priority behavior. That touched the ingress routing map and a small nginx tweak we rolled out with it.
josh: Quick check — during the tweak we added a temp header sanitize in nginx to drop some incoming headers. snippet from ingress conf:
```
# temporary workaround for client-proxy
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
proxy_set_header Traceparent "";  # oops
```
maya: oh no — that would strip traceparent. but why do parents remain? seems like parents are created at the edge before ingress (edge proxy -> parent created), children from internal workers rely on tracecontext propagation to attach.
karim: Collector logs show repeated 429s then exponential backoff; children created after the backoff sometimes have no parent link because context was lost/recreated. Also saw queue_size hits and exporter-retry drops. paste from collector.log:
```
2026-03-20T02:11:58Z exporter/trace_archive send error: 429 Too Many Requests (Retry-After: 60)
2026-03-20T02:12:05Z queue/overflow drop count=183
```
maya: Also found retention-cleaner logs at 02:20:02 deleting spans: "deleted 9,041,213 spans from dataset prod-traces". My local var for retention was mis-set during a config test (RETENTION_DAYS=0.041) and the template accidentally pointed prod-cleaner at the test value when pushed. I'm opening a rollback.
rachel: Ugh. So two problems overlapped: header trimming + exporter backlog + accidental low retention. Explains why parents look present (edge created) but many child spans missing and some full datasets disappeared.
nina: Can we confirm which customers lost trace continuity? Quick query:
```
curl -sS "https://tracing.redwood.internal/api/v1/query?service=inference&since=2026-03-20T01:50Z" | jq '.hits|length'
```
josh: Running queries now. Early result: several high-volume customers show gaps between parent and worker spans across 02:10-02:30 UTC.
karim: Mitigations in flight: 1) rollback routing policy to previous variant (rachel) 2) patch ingress to stop stripping Traceparent (josh) 3) bump collector exporter queue and reduce aggressive backoff (karim) 4) restore retention window from backup snapshot (maya)
rachel: Rolling back routing flag now.
deploy-bot: rollout: flag routing-priority reverted by rachel at 02:38 UTC
josh: Patching nginx — removed proxy_set_header Traceparent line and reloaded at 02:44. Confirmed Traceparent passes through to services again.
karim: Increased otel-collector exporter queue_size from 1000->4000 and enabled retry_on_failure with linear backoff. Restarted collectors via k8s rollout at 02:50.
maya: Retention rolled back to 30 days from backup snapshot at 03:10; we recovered some spans but not all — many were shredded by the cleaner.
nina: Status: child spans reappearing for new requests; historical continuity partial for affected window. Impacted requests between 02:10-02:25 have gaps; we can backfill some but not all.
karim: Root cause summary: (1) ingress header sanitization removed Traceparent leading to broken propagation (2) collector exporter overloaded/429s causing queue drops and temporary loss (3) accidental retention misconfig accelerated data loss. Multiple failures overlapped during the rollout.
maya: Postmortem actions I'm taking: add a pre-deploy check to validate RETENTION_* envs; require an approval for retention changes; run a dry-run for header-preserving regex in ingress before rollout.
rachel: Ops/Ux follow-up: we need rollout UI to highlight cross-service env changes (routing flag that also nudges ingress change). I'll open a small RFC for safer rollout choreography.
josh: Added an automated alert: otel-collector exporter_rate_limit > 10 per min and queue_drop > 5 will page oncall now.
nina: Thanks everyone. Can we capture this thread as an incident note and add to incidents/ if we want a formal postmortem? I'll start the incident doc and ping you for details.
karim: I'll attach collector logs + config diffs to the incident. Also a quick fix PR to avoid emptying Traceparent in nginx: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/582
maya: Creating follow-up tickets: #INFRA-4201 (retention guard), #PLATFORM-2290 (rollout UX), #OBS-3156 (collector queue tuning).
nina: ok, closing this Slack thread. Thanks all :heart:
